data.one_liner: Create dotted lines, dashed shapes, and dotted borders for widgets.
data.what_it_does: FDottedLine lets developers easily draw horizontal or vertical dotted lines, build dashed rectangular shapes, and add custom dotted borders with rounded corners to any Flutter widget.
use_when: You need to display a dashed or dotted line separator
You want to add a dotted border around a widget or container
You need custom rounded corner effects on dashed borders
avoid_when: You require complex vector graphics or path manipulations beyond simple dashed lines and rectangles
You only need standard solid borders natively supported by BoxDecoration
strengths: Very simple API for creating dotted lines and borders
Supports wrapping arbitrary widgets to give them dotted borders
Supports custom corner effects, segment lengths, spacing, and thickness
weaknesses: Limited to basic lines, rectangles, and corner variations
License is unknown in pubspec metadata
data.minimal_example:
FDottedLine(
  color: Colors.blue,
  width: 160.0,
  strokeWidth: 2.0,
  dottedLength: 10.0,
  space: 2.0,
)
